title: Instagram
caption_text:
I had to undergo a small surgery that will keep me off the court for a few weeks. Everything went well, and I’m already working on my recovery.

Thank you for all your messages and support. I’ll be back soon 🤍
method: Chromium renders original public Instagram page; no DOM, CSS, text or image content alteration; only viewport sizing, normal Close button for sign-up prompt, and natural scroll.
boundary: Original Instagram post screenshot, unlike WTA reporting screenshot; exact post time must be taken from time element, not inferred from WTA publication date.
visual_review_reason: Actual screenshots were obscured by sign-up/open-app modal; normal Close operation removed post content instead of providing an unobstructed caption screenshot. No DOM/CSS removal or recreation used.
